answer: A bond is refunded only after 49 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The pearl counter is kept in lantern and vertex reveals each reset. A hostile operator as a result has to keep each alias continuously active for 49 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 68 dollars in locked collateral and another 8 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
